source_text: In high-risk African settings, VMMC interventions have demonstrated epidemiological causality through time-series declines in incidence post-uptake, exceeding expectations from behavioral interventions alone, whereas low-prevalence contexts like Europe show minimal marginal gains due to already subdued transmission dynamics.
